children: CapsoVision entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement for a registered direct offering of 3,163,444 shares of common stock at $5.69 per share, a roughly 5% discount to the prior Nasdaq close. The offering, made without an underwriter, is to existing stockholders including Star One Global Capital and Eliyahou Harari, and is expected to close on or about September 18, 2026. Gross proceeds are approximately $18 million, which the company plans to use for general corporate purposes, including sales and marketing, R&D, G&A, and working capital.
